title: Gammon, white bean and pointed cabbage pot

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Gammon, tinned beans, stock, crème fraîche and mustard are all ordinary kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board and one wide lidded pan, with simple browning and simmering.

works.reason: 400g gammon, two tins of beans and a whole cabbage make a good amount for four, the salty gammon and stock make extra salt unnecessary, and the liquid and timings are sound.

honest_times.reason: 15 minutes covers the dicing and shredding, and the 20-minute cook time is close enough to the steps, since the chopping can be done while the gammon browns.

honest_ingredients.reason: Gammon steaks match the gammon id, and every listed ingredient and seasoning is used with nothing unlisted.

seasonal_feel.reason: A whole pointed cabbage gives the pot its bulk, and a quick, light bean pot finished with crème fraîche suits an August lunch.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Protein, pulses and plenty of vegetables make a filling family meal.
